design_decisions.decision: Project all of it this generation: visibility/is_async/is_unsafe/is_extern/abi as node attributes (cheap scalars, all real), plus HAS_PARAMETER_TYPE (one edge per parameter, with position+name attributes) and HAS_RETURN_TYPE (when Some) edges converging on the same Type nodes TYPE's own observations produce. Unlike the FunctionIdentity fix (which deliberately left FunctionIdentity.generics for later to keep that generation narrow), this arm had literally zero prior projection of ANY field beyond a display string and zero prior test coverage -- fixing it completely in one generation is the narrower, more coherent unit of work here, not scope creep. design_decisions.question: Edge kind names?
design_decisions.decision: HAS_PARAMETER_TYPE and HAS_RETURN_TYPE, following this file's own established convention (IMPLEMENTED_ON, BINDS_ARGUMENT/BINDS_RESULT, REFERS_TO_PLACE, MAKES_CALL -- one distinct, clearly-named kind per distinct relationship).
